STRICT SCREEN

Evidence before an option contract.

Tier 1: Autodesk, Reddit, Adobe. Research first, with disclosed risks. Tier 2: Accenture, Intuit, Salesforce, HubSpot. Profitable businesses with cash-flow, margin, growth or leverage exceptions.

Tier 3: Samsara is an early watch excluded from the qualified list because valuation and stock compensation are too demanding.

Scoring: 25 fundamentals + 20 earnings + 15 valuation + 15 catalysts + 10 moat + 5 macro + 5 technicals + 5 options. All receive zero option points because live IV, open interest, delta and spreads could not be verified.

High reference: use the stated 52-week high or older ATH. ADSK's ATH is from 2021; CRM from 2024; IOT from 2025. They are not all 30% below their recent 52-week highs. Mechanical recovery upside is not a forecast.

LEAPS: verify listed 18–30 month expirations and ~0.70–0.85 delta ITM calls. Check spread, IV, open interest, break-even and post-earnings volatility before choosing a contract. Entire option premium is at risk.

Coverage: targeted audited research, not an exhaustive automatic market-wide scan. Financial comparisons use the same fiscal quarter YoY; primary statements resolve source conflicts.
